children: Sweden financial services group's Q3 net profit declined 2% yr/yr to SEK 7.5 bln
Operating profit for Q3 fell 3% yr/yr, net financial income impacted by muted client activity
Company expects 2026 full-year costs to be SEK 500-600 mln below target
SEB expects 2026 full-year costs to be SEK 500-600 mln below target
CUSTOMER ACTIVITY - SEB said overall customer activity and credit demand remained solid across divisions, per Acting CEO Jonas Ahlström
NET FINANCIAL INCOME - SEB said net financial income was negatively impacted by muted client activity and a challenging market-making environment
COST MANAGEMENT - SEB said ongoing cost consolidation is expected to bring 2026 full-year costs SEK 500-600 mln below target
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 9 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB (publ) is SEK235.00, about 8% above its October 21 closing price of SEK217.50
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
